analysis: Test 2 sensitivity: product-clustered spline Wald test

hypotheses.H0: All four spline basis coefficients equal zero
hypotheses.H1: At least one spline basis coefficient is nonzero

method: Joint Wald test using product-clustered covariance from a grouped-binomial GLM
caution: This robust Wald test assesses whether the spline terms jointly contribute beyond the linear effect. It does not prove superior out-of-sample prediction. Cluster-robust inference remains asymptotic, and the model may still have misspecification or overdispersion concerns.
